scenario.goal_zh: 说明衣物破损并约定修补和取件

context_zh: 顾客把一件准备参加正式晚宴穿的旧外套送去修补。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Cass
sentences.text: Could you repair this hole near the pocket? I caught it on a nail.

sentences.speaker: Tailor Ren
sentences.text: Let me see. I can mend it, though a small mark may remain.

sentences.speaker: Cass
sentences.text: It's for a formal dinner on Saturday. Would the mark be noticeable?

sentences.speaker: Tailor Ren
sentences.text: Not from a distance. The pocket flap covers most of it.

sentences.speaker: Cass
sentences.text: Good. I know this style is out of fashion, but I still like the jacket.

sentences.speaker: Tailor Ren
sentences.text: It suits you. I can have the repair ready by Friday afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Cass
sentences.text: Friday is perfect. Please go ahead with the repair.
